title: Combat Dyes Mod
description: A mod that gives combat uses for dyes
body:
# **Brief Overview**
  This mod adds 6 special dyes: red, brown, yellow, green, white, and black. Each dye provides a unique effect that can be applied to players and mobs.

  You'll need the new mortar item to create these special dyes. When applied to swords, they grant powerful effects to your weapons.

  It's in english and spanish

# Golden Yellow Dye
 Grants the effects of a Golden Apple when attacking enemies.

# Electrified Red Dye
 Temporarily negates your opponent's armor, making them vulnerable for several seconds.
 
# Thorny Green Dye
 Causes damage to enemies when they move or jump in any direction.

# Cold White Dye
  Applies Weakness, Slowness, and causes progressive damage over time.

# Charred Black Dye
  Extends the duration of burning effects and inflicts Blindness.

# Clumpy Brown Dye
 Immobilizes opponents, preventing them from escaping.
